```yaml
name: Tag Report

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v0.9.1'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v3
      with:
        go-version: '1.18'

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./...

    - name: Generate coverage report
      run: |
        go install github.com/go-critic/gocritic/cmd/gocritic@latest
        gocritic check --all
        go install github.com/mattn/goveralls@v0.0.14
        goveralls -service=github

  release:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v3
      with:
        go-version: '1.18'

    - name: Create release
      id: create_release
      uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        tag_name: v0.9.1
        name: Release v0.9.1
        draft: false
        prerelease: false

    - name: Upload assets
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v2
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
        asset_path: ./path/to/your/assets
        asset_name: your_asset_name
        asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
```

yaml:
name: Tag Report

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v0.9.1'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v3
      with:
        go-version: '1.18'

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./...

    - name: Generate coverage report
      run: |
        go install github.com/go-critic/gocritic/cmd/gocritic@latest
        gocritic check --all
        go install github.com/mattn/goveralls@v0.0.14
        goveralls -service=github

  release:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v3
      with:
        go-version: '1.18'

    - name: Create release
      id: create_release
      uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        tag_name: v0.9.1
        name: Release v0.9.1
        draft: false
        prerelease: false

    - name: Upload assets
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v2
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
        asset_path: ./path/to/your/assets
        asset_name: your_asset_name
        asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
